title: EU AI Act Article 10 — Data and data governance
description: The training-data quality and governance requirement for high-risk AI systems under the EU AI Act, referenced here as a general data-governance anchor extending naturally to training-data sourcing/provenance practices, though Article 10 is framed primarily around bias/quality rather than IP specifically. Paraphrase pending verification against the primary EUR-Lex text — hence 'Community' confidence.
control_text: Training, validation, and testing data for high-risk AI systems must meet quality criteria — relevant, representative, and examined for errors and biases — with appropriate data governance and management practices applied to how the data is sourced, prepared, and documented.

citations.title: Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 laying down harmonised rules on artificial intelligence (Artificial Intelligence Act)
citations.publisher: EUR-Lex / Official Journal of the European Union

relationships.reason: Satisfying this control's data-governance practices is documented via the training data provenance log.
